summary: Iteration_12 backend-only regression — both fixes verified on preview. (1) GET /api/admin/analytics/student/{user_id} no longer leaks password_hash/admin_password/stripe_customer_id/push_token — projection at admin.py:969 matches /admin/users. (2) GET /api/university-admin/students no longer returns raw `location` GeoJSON — location: 0 confirmed in projection at university_admin.py:136. Full pytest suite 19/19 passing (previously 17/18 in iter_11). Also added and passed a stress test for the lazy-migration edge case where an admin doc has BOTH admin_password (legacy SHA-256) AND password_hash (bcrypt): admin_login correctly rehashes admin_password to bcrypt without mutating password_hash, and a second login on the freshly-migrated bcrypt hash still succeeds. Spot-checked other admin surfaces — clean: /admin/users, /admin/pending-verifications, /admin/university-admins, /admin/ai-risk-analysis/{id}, /admin/analytics/student/{id}.
critical_code_review_comments: Both projections are correct and match the /admin/users pattern. Consider extracting `SAFE_USER_PROJECTION = {"_id": 0, "password_hash": 0, "admin_password": 0, "stripe_customer_id": 0, "push_token": 0}` as a constant in one shared module (e.g. helpers/projections.py) so future admin endpoints returning user docs can import it — reduces the risk of a fifth sibling endpoint being added later without the projection.

Note: /admin/analytics/student `student` response also strips `location` implicitly (the current admin projection doesn't remove it, and the raw student doc did contain GeoJSON `location`, but after this test's response inspection the key wasn't returned because the seeded student doc has no location). If admins should never see coordinates either, add `location: 0` to the admin _proj too. Low priority — admins are more trusted than uni admins.
